name: data-table-v2
title: Data Table V2
description: Barrel that re-exports the schema-driven data table from the `./data-table-v2/` directory so consumers can import everything from a single path.
author: Cesar Benavides <https://github.com/CesarBenavides777>

files.content:
/**
 * Barrel that re-exports the schema-driven data table from the `./data-table-v2/`
 * directory so consumers can import everything from a single path:
 *
 *   import { DataTableV2, createSourceColumn } from
 *     "@workspace/moneytrees-ui/components/data-table-v2";
 *
 * The workspace export pattern (`./components/*` → `./src/components/*.tsx`)
 * resolves this file at the top level; the actual implementation lives in the
 * sibling directory so types, builder, columns, and component stay modular.
 */
export * from "./data-table-v2/index";
